sentence: We agree with the learned counsel for the petitioner that the High Court could not have placed reliance on the judgments in the cases of Habib Ullah (supra) and Bashir Ahmed (supra) which had restricted the scope and applicability of the 2005 Act and had been declared by the five member bench of this court in the case of Gulshan Bibi vs. Muhammad Sadiq (PLD 2016 SC 769) as “not a good law.”

Both judgments were expressly approved, whereas the contrary interpretation adopted in Abdul Rahim and others v. United Bank Ltd. (PLD 1997 Karachi 62) was disapproved and declared not to represent the correct legal position.
